techniques.name: Network Service Discovery
techniques.rationale: Many short flows to varied destination ports match reconnaissance scanning behaviour.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol

techniques.name: Drive-by Compromise
techniques.rationale: XSS payloads may be delivered via web; network flow metadata does not prove script execution.

techniques.name: Remote Services

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
